headline: Montenegro warns that "times are not for jokes" and calls on the opposition for responsibility over the Budget
summary: The Montenegrin prime minister appealed to the opposition to act responsibly when considering the next state budget. He said this was needed to maintain political stability.
why: The state budget sets public spending and borrowing plans, which affect sovereign debt and investor confidence in Montenegro.
